reason: The README describes a skill and plugin that preprocesses images and calls configurable vision-model APIs for image description, visual question answering, OCR, and multi-image comparison, so media-tools is the primary category.

summaries.zh: 通过兼容 OpenAI 的视觉模型 API 为文本模型提供图片描述、图像问答、OCR 和多图对比能力。
summaries.en: Provides image description, visual question answering, OCR, and multi-image comparison for text-only models through configurable OpenAI-compatible vision APIs.
